description: Create STOCKHISTORYARCHIVE table for archiving old StockHistory records
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: STOCKHISTORY table must exist (it is the source of cloned schema)

migrationSteps.description: Detect actual table name case for STOCKHISTORY and STOCKHISTORYARCHIVE
CREATE TABLE STOCKHISTORYARCHIVE LIKE STOCKHISTORY (clones columns and indexes, no FKs)
Remove AUTO_INCREMENT from ID column so archived rows keep their original StockHistory IDs
Add ARCHIVEDAT DATETIME column for tracking when each row was archived
Add index on CREATEDAT for efficient archive cutoff and lookup queries
Verify schema, column count and presence of ID/CREATEDAT/ARCHIVEDAT columns

expectedOutcome.primaryFix: STOCKHISTORYARCHIVE table available for the archival job to move rows older than the configured retention window
expectedOutcome.impact: Empty table created; no data movement yet. Archival itself is performed by the application's scheduled or manual archive job.

rollbackNotes: Rollback DROPs STOCKHISTORYARCHIVE. If the table has been populated, archived data will be lost.
Take a backup of STOCKHISTORYARCHIVE before rollback if its rows are still needed.
relatedIssue: #20726 - perf: archive old StockHistory records to reduce 850MB table bloat
